gloss: after all; you see; the thing is

definitions.gloss: after all; you see; the thing is
definitions.explanation: Introduces a key explanatory fact or reason that makes the speaker's point understandable. A more casual, conversational variant of なにしろ.

examples.japanese: なにせ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: The thing is, it's my first time, so of course I'm nervous.

examples.japanese: なにせ⟦{忙|いそが}しくて→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧、⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧⟦{暇|ひま}→暇：00592_hima⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: You see, I was so busy I didn't even have time to get in touch.

examples.japanese: なにせ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧⟦チャンピオン→チャンピオン：19399_chanpion⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{勝|か}てる→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}っていない→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: After all, the opponent is a world champion, so I don't expect to win.

notes:
A casual conversational variant of なにしろ; both introduce a strong reason or excuse. Placed at the beginning of a sentence or clause, typically followed by ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ or ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- なにせ〜⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: after all, because ~
- なにせ〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で: since, after all, ~
- なにせ〜んだ: the thing is ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- なにしろ: same meaning, slightly more formal
- ⟦とにかく→とにかく：03464_tonikaku⟧: anyway; in any case — less explanatory, often used to redirect a topic
- ⟦{何|なん}といっても→何といっても：28992_nantoittemo⟧: above all; most importantly — emphasizes the most outstanding point
